description: This file contains functions and type definitions for converting Anthropic messages into Mistral-compatible message formats, including ID normalization, message transformation, and handling of different message roles.

methods.name: normalizeMistralToolCallId
methods.description: Normalizes a tool call ID to be exactly 9 alphanumeric characters, extracting alphanumeric characters and padding or truncating as needed.

methods.name: convertToMistralMessages
methods.description: Converts an array of Anthropic messages into Mistral-compatible message format, handling different roles and message content types.
